title: Second Aceh Expedition
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Second Aceh Expedition", at revision 1365848931, opens: "The Dutch dispatched a second expedition in Aceh in late 1873 during the Aceh War following the failed First Aceh Expedition of the Royal Netherlands East Indies Army to Aceh." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2259923, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1873 Dutch punitive expedition with officers recruited from Elmina". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
